Assert-That ($definition.value.status -ceq 'passed' -and @($definition.value.tasks).Count -eq 3) 'Expected all three exact configured task definitions.'
    $configuredRows=@($definition.value.tasks)
    $configuredSpecs=@(
        @{name=$FailedFirstName;created=$failedFirstCreation.value;helper='windows-configured-launch-host-memory-20261127.ps1';helper_sha256='8db39140f935b690af58fc2c604ba7a0566945f7c4ea140d6f98637ead75c5ae';last_result=1},
        @{name=$FailedSecondName;created=$failedSecondCreation.value;helper='windows-configured-launch-host-crlf-20261127.ps1';helper_sha256='f15cdc8bf98d8565a111951cc6b6dac7200a890e47758971470b3cbbf1395880';last_result=1},
        @{name=$ConfiguredName;created=$creation.value;helper='windows-configured-launch-host-session-20261127.ps1';helper_sha256=$ConfiguredHelperSha;last_result=0}
    )
    for($i=0;$i -lt $configuredSpecs.Count;$i++){
        $spec=$configuredSpecs[$i];$created=$spec.created;$row=$configuredRows[$i]
        Assert-That ($created.status -ceq 'registered_before_run' -and $created.task -ceq $spec.name -and $created.user -ceq 'DESKTOP-NRIGAJU\YossiMH' -and $created.session_id -eq 1) 'Configured creation receipt differs.'
        Assert-That ($created.registration_flags -eq 2 -and $created.run_flags -eq 4 -and $created.run_level -eq 0 -and $created.priority -eq 7) 'Configured registration contract differs.'
        $helperPath=Join-Path $TaskRoot ('final-installation-v9-20261125-1151\'+$spec.helper)
        $helperInput=@($created.inputs|Where-Object{$_.path -ceq $helperPath})
        Assert-That ($helperInput.Count -eq 1 -and $helperInput[0].sha256 -ceq $spec.helper_sha256) 'Configured creation was not bound to its accepted helper.'
        Assert-That ($row.name -ceq $spec.name -and $row.path -ceq ('\'+$spec.name) -and @($row.actions).Count -eq 1 -and $row.last_result -eq $spec.last_result) 'Configured definition identity or completed outcome differs.'
        $action=@($row.actions)[0]
        Assert-That ($action.type -eq 0 -and $action.path -ceq $created.action_path -and $action.arguments -ceq $created.action_arguments -and $action.working_directory -ceq $created.working_directory) 'Configured definition differs from its accepted creation action.'
        Assert-That ($row.principal.run_level -eq 0 -and $row.principal.logon_type -eq 3 -and $row.settings.priority -eq 7 -and $row.settings.hidden -eq $true -and $row.settings.enabled -eq $true -and $row.settings.execution_time_limit -ceq 'PT2M30S' -and $row.settings.multiple_instances -eq 2) 'Configured task settings differ.'
